{{Quote|This was the first sign of the Sith Empire's return, and the last day we enjoyed the peace so many of us had come to take for granted. It was a day that forever changed the course of Republic history. We now know, of course, that the Empire had been preparing for their attack for decades, if not centuries.|[[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Satele Shan]]|<ref name="Gnost-Dural" />}}
In [[3681 BBY]], the '''assault on the Tingel Arm region''' occurred between the ancient [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] upon the Empire's return to known [[Realspace/Legends|space]]. After hiding in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] for centuries following their defeat in the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]], the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] rebuilt their Empire and readied for war against the Republic. Led by a [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord]] known as the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]], Imperial [[Harrower-class dreadnought|battlecruisers]] appeared on the fringes of the [[Tingel Arm/Legends|Tingel Arm]]. The Republic dispatched a [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomatic]] [[Convoy/Legends|convoy]] to meet the [[Warship/Legends|warships]] and discern their intent, but the convoy was quickly destroyed by the Sith forces. This battle was the first in the devastating [[Great Galactic War]], which dragged on for twenty-eight [[Standard year/Legends|years]] and eventually enveloped [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

==Prelude==
{{Quote|Sith battlecruisers first appeared on the fringes of the Tingel Arm. Unaware of the ship's origins, we dispatched a diplomatic convoy with a small starfighter escort.|Jedi Master Gnost-Dural|<ref name="Timeline 6" />}}
[[File:RepublicDiplomaticConvoy-Timeline6.jpg|thumb|left|220px|The Republic's diplomatic convoy]]
Following the [[Second battle of Korriban|end]] of the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]], [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] at large believed the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] to be extinct. In truth, one of the Empire's few surviving [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]] had fled to [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] to build a [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|new Sith dominion]] in secrecy, planning to one day return and destroy the Republic.<ref name="Dromund Kaas">{{Holonet|planets|dromund-kaas|Dromund Kaas}}</ref> The Republic, meanwhile, operated in ignorance of the surviving Sith Empire, enjoying peaceful expansion that was occasionally interrupted by various [[Old Sith Wars|conflicts]] instigated by claimants to the Sith title.<ref name="KotOR II">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''</ref>

In [[3681 BBY]],<ref name="Timeline6date" /> the rebuilt Empire's leader, known as the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]], believed his preparations for the return of the Sith Empire to the galaxy were complete. A number of [[Harrower-class dreadnought|''Harrower''-class dreadnaughts]] traveled to the fringes of the [[Tingel Arm/Legends|Tingel Arm]], a far reach of Republic [[Realspace/Legends|space]]. The Republic was informed of their appearance but was unaware that the [[Starship/Legends|vessels]] belonged to its ancient nemesis. To discern the intent of the mysterious fleet, a [[Convoy/Legends|convoy]] of Republic [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomats]], escorted by a small [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]], was sent to rendezvous with the [[Battlecruiser/Legends|battlecruisers]].<ref name="Timeline 6" />

==The assault==
{{Quote|The diplomats had just enough time to transmit images back, then they were annihilated.|Gnost-Dural|<ref name="Timeline 6" />}}
The diplomats arrived in the Tingel Arm and were greeted by the [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] of battlecruisers. The [[Republic transport ship|diplomats' transport]] began transmitting images of the fleet back to the Republic, but the transmission was cut off when the battlecruisers opened [[Laser/Legends|fire]]. The entire Republic force was annihilated by the Imperial ships,<ref name="Timeline 6" /> resulting in the loss of hundreds of Republic lives.<ref name="Gnost-Dural" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|Beside the unsettling nature of any such military threat, the images left me with a feeling even more ominous and more uncomfortable than what I would have expected.|Gnost-Dural|<ref name="Gnost-Dural" />}}
[[File:Tingel_Arm.jpg|thumb|right|260px|The site of the assault]]
The assault in the Tingel Arm ignited a galaxy-wide conflict known as the [[Great Galactic War]]. Public knowledge of the attack was not known until after the [[Battle of Korriban]], but the video of the Empire's return incited fear and uncertainty when it was finally broadcast.<ref name="Gnost-Dural" /> With their Empire revealed to the galaxy, the Sith began a ruthless campaign of conquest throughout the rest of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The Emperor's forces immediately [[Assault on the Aparo sector|invaded]] the [[Aparo sector/Legends|Aparo sector]], seizing control of it and much of the remaining Tingel Arm. After a [[Tingel Arm campaign|delayed response]] to the seizure of the Aparo [[Sector/Legends|sector]], the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] was pushed out from the Tingel Arm and forced to operate on the defensive for the remainder of the twenty-eight&ndash;year&ndash;long war. Following the end of the war with the signing of the [[Treaty of Coruscant]], the [[Kel Dor/Legends|Kel Dor]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Gnost-Dural]] made a [[Holodocumentary|holorecord]] of the events surrounding the beginning of the Great Galactic War, including the assault in the Tingel Arm.<ref name="Timeline 6" /> [[The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural|The journal]] of Master Gnost-Dural also contained a first-hand account of the Kel Dor's experiences upon learning of the assault; the work was one of the first added to the new [[Jedi Archives (Tython)|Jedi Archives]] on [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].<ref name="Gnost-Dural" />

==Behind the scenes==
The assault in the Tingel Arm region was first introduced, albeit unnamed, in [[Timeline 6: Onslaught of the Sith Empire|''Onslaught of the Sith Empire'']], the sixth installment of the ''[[Galactic Timeline]]''. The timeline is a series of web videos presented as historical accounts on the history behind the [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|computer game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''; the installments are made available on the game's [http://swtor.com official site] and are narrated by [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi Master]] Gnost-Dural, who is voiced by actor [[Lance Henriksen]].<ref name="News">{{TORweb|url=news/news-article/20100122_001|text=Onslaught of the Sith Empire|nolive=1}}</ref> The assault was later identified in the [[2012]] reference title ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''<ref name="TORE">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''.</ref>
